title: Shared definitions of the v0 schemas

apiVersion.description: Version of the configuration format. A document written for another version is rejected rather than guessed at.

name.description: Name of an agent, mandate, manifest, team or limit: lower case, digits, '.', '_' and '-', starting and ending with a letter or digit.

id.description: Opaque identifier issued by the box (grant, consent, decision, approval). By convention it starts with a type prefix such as grt_ or cns_.

clientId.description: OAuth client identifier (RFC 6749 §2.2), as an identity provider or the box issued it.

subjectId.description: A person as their identity provider names them. An OIDC sub is unique only within its issuer, so the two travel together (RFC 9493, iss_sub format).

approvers.description: Who may approve: the user the agent acts for, or members of groups at an identity provider.

timestamp.description: Time in a record: UTC with exactly millisecond precision, so the record has one serialization for the hash chain.

operation.description: Name of an operation as the manifest declares it: the MCP tool name, or the name given to an HTTP route. No wildcards: a grant lists every operation it covers.

audience.description: Resource server identifier (RFC 8707 resource indicator, RFC 9396 locations).

pointer.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) into the arguments of an operation call. The root pointer "" is not a field and is not allowed.

digest.description: SHA-256 digest, base64url without padding, with its algorithm prefix.

sensitivity.description: Tier of an operation. read runs on any valid grant. write runs too, and the record is kept for review. critical never runs on a standing grant: a person approves the exact call first.

constraintBounds.description: The ready-made constraint types. Every bound listed for a field must hold; a constrained field missing from the call fails the check. Each type can be compared with a narrower one, which is what makes 'request ⊆ grant' and narrowing on delegation decidable.

constraint.description: Constraint on one field, keyed in its permission by the argument's JSON Pointer.

permission.description: What may be called, where, and with which argument values, as written in an agent or a mandate.

authorizationDetail.description: One authorization_details entry of a grant (RFC 9396).

limit.description: A budget. count limits the number of calls; sum limits the total of a numeric field. actions, when present, restricts the operations the limit counts. per says over what the budget runs: one grant, or a calendar day or month of the consent.
